feed.title: AION Analytics OSS Releases
feed.description: Announcements for AION Analytics public package and model updates.

releases.summary: Discovery tightening, explicit upgrade guidance, and packaged NSE circular holiday-shift helpers.
highlights: Added exact-search README and metadata phrasing for Indian market calendar, NSE, MCX, and market-open workflows.
Added a deterministic comparison page for aion-indian-market-calendar vs pandas_market_calendars.
Added explicit user guidance to upgrade the package when Muhurat timings or other calendar changes ship in a new release.
Added packaged live-override helpers for shifting known holiday groups such as Bakri Id when an NSE circular revises the trading-holiday date.
validation: python -c "from aion_indian_market_calendar.live_overrides import match_known_holiday_names; print('Bakri Id' in match_known_holiday_names('NSE trading holiday update for Bakri Id'))"

releases.summary: Timezone fallback fix for environments without system tzdata.
highlights: Added tzdata dependency for ZoneInfo compatibility.
Added pytz fallback for constrained runtimes such as Pyodide.
Corrected naive datetime attachment in fallback mode.
validation: python -c "from aion_indian_market_calendar import IndiaMarketCalendar; from datetime import datetime; import pytz; cal=IndiaMarketCalendar(); print(cal.get_session(datetime(2026,1,27,9,5,tzinfo=pytz.timezone('Asia/Kolkata')), market='NFO') is not None)"

releases.summary: Canonical market resolution fix for aliases and index inputs.
highlights: NFO and FNO now resolve to NSE_EQUITY_DERIVATIVES.
NIFTY and BANKNIFTY now resolve to derivatives by default.
Unknown market inputs now raise ValueError instead of failing silently.
validation: python -c "from aion_indian_market_calendar import IndiaMarketCalendar; from datetime import datetime; import pytz; cal=IndiaMarketCalendar(); dt=datetime(2026,1,27,9,20,tzinfo=pytz.timezone('Asia/Kolkata')); print(cal.get_session(dt, market='NFO') is not None); print(cal.get_session(dt, market='NIFTY') is not None)"

releases.summary: Public identity cleanup to AION Indian Market Intelligence for Macro Event & Sector Impact Analysis.
highlights: Standardizes the public product identity as AION Indian Market Intelligence for Macro Event & Sector Impact Analysis.
Defines sector_vector as the canonical sector impact analysis output.

Replaces execution-oriented framing across package, MCP, HF, and marketplace assets with Indian market intelligence, macro event analysis, sector impact analysis, policy impact analysis, event-driven market intelligence, economic propagation analysis, and sector effect modeling.
validation: python -c "from aion_indian_market_intelligence import analyze; r=analyze('RBI hikes repo rate by 25 bps'); print('sector_vector' in r); print('sector_directional_bias' in r)"
